title: Casting a positive integer to int preserves positivity

ground_truth.statement: For an int, an int cast is the identity, so a positive-int remains positive. The controls include 1 and PHP_INT_MAX.

provenance.note: The source suppresses RedundantCast. Suppression removed intentionally; this measures both refinement preservation and any redundant-cast diagnostic policy.

notes: PHPStan is clean. Mago reports invalid-return-statement at line 7, widening the positive input to int across an identity cast; runtime and integer-cast semantics contradict that report. Psalm reports RedundantCastGivenDocblockType at line 7, which confirms it retains the positive range but objects to redundant syntax. That is a policy disagreement against the clean semantic baseline, not evidence the cast loses positivity. Both FP labels remain visible, with their different meanings documented.
